svg.title: Maximum on a closed disk and supremum on an open disk
svg.desc: Two equal-scale Cartesian panels show the unit disk and the parallel level lines 3x+4y=3 and 3x+4y=5. The latter supports the disk at P=(3/5,4/5). In the closed disk the boundary and P are included, so the maximum is 5. In the open disk the dashed boundary and hollow point P are excluded, so there is no maximum. Interior points on the ray toward P approach it and their objective values approach the supremum 5.
